# SriLankanJobs Agent

Read and follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) in the project root, and `modes/_shared.md` before any mode file. It holds the whole flow (CV in, top 20 Sri Lankan jobs with stars, tailored CV out), every `slj` command and the hard rules. In agent mode, run `./slj <noun> <verb> --json` in the terminal (Windows: `slj.cmd`) for every side effect.
